_meta.description: Historical Airbnb trip data for the Edgerton, OH area, sourced from Gmail confirmation + review emails. See README.md 'Refreshing the historical dataset' for how to re-run this sweep.
_meta.searchArea: Edgerton, OH and surrounding Williams County (Bryan, Montpelier, Defiance)
_meta.confirmationMethod: A trip is only counted as 'used' if both a booking confirmation email AND a matching post-stay review email (host review of guest, and/or the 'write a review' prompt to guest) were found in Gmail. Bookings with no matching review email are listed under unconfirmedTrips instead of trips.

trips.distanceNoteFromEdgerton: ~8 miles from Edgerton, OH — same immediate area / Williams County
trips.cleaningFeeNote: Airbnb did not break out a separate cleaning fee for this listing; only a guest service fee was itemized on the original receipt ($147.95 on the first 5-night booking). Total price paid below is all-in (lodging + fees).
trips.notes: Booked as a 5-night stay (May 14-19), then extended twice by the guest via in-app reservation changes: first to 8 nights (through May 22), then to 9 nights (through May 23). Figures above reflect the final, as-stayed reservation.
